Want to learn about brushing and snacks together?

Ages 1 and 2 are an important time when eating habits and brushing habits develop.

"What snacks should I choose?" "My child refuses to brush…" "When should we visit the dentist?"

Our health nurse and nutritionist will answer your questions!

Contents
• Points to prevent cavities
• How to choose and eat snacks
• How to brush teeth
• When to visit the dentist

One-on-one consultations are available for those who wish!

Who can attend
Residents of Hanno City with children aged 1 and 2, and their guardians

Date and time
September 17, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 10:00 a.m.

Location
Health Center (Kenko Center)

What to bring
Maternal and Child Health Handbook (Boshi Kenko Techō)

Registration
Capacity: 10 groups. Advance registration required.

Please apply using the form below.

Application form
